crossRefs.note: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South, and on Ziklag…
and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them…
Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will…
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of…

translations.web: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning, and have light, depart.”
translations.bsb: Now then, get up early in the morning, along with your master’s servants who came with you, and go as soon as it is light.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
translations.asv: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of thy lord that are come with thee; and as soon as ye are up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
